dct_title_s: Preliminary Satellite Derived Flood Evolution Assessment, Islamic Republic of Pakistan-11 October 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20220808PAK, GDACS Id: 1101522** Status: Overall decrease of flood waters observed Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings; Evolution of Cumulative Flood Waters over I.R. of Pakistan (26 September-2 October 2022 Vs 03-09 October 2022): Between 03 and 09 October 2022 approximately 13 million people remain potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas; Based on satellite observations between 26 September and 02 October 2022 and compared with observations between 03 and 09 October 2022, the overall flood water extent appears to continue to decrease with approximately 300 km² in Balochistan, ~Punjab 900 km²  and  ~4,000 km² in Sindh.
